{{Quote|As you may have noticed, Tol Ado is buried at all times by heavy cloud cover. These clouds contain a mixture of hydrogen fluoride, hydrogen sulfate, hydrogen chloride, carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide, and other chemicals generally fatal to most life-forms.|Lieutenant [[Salva]], to a tour group|<ref name="JH">''[[Jedi's Honor]]''</ref>}}
'''Hydrogen sulfate''' was a [[Gas/Legends|gas]]. It was present in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of [[Tol Ado]].<ref name="JH" />

{{Substance-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hydrogen sulfate was mentioned in ''[[Jedi's Honor]]'', a [[1990]] [[West End Games]] solitaire [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventure authored by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="JH" />
